look: Eclipse Core Golem, a B-rank GKOM variant from the Eclipse Golems family: titan of black stone and crystal around an eclipsed core. Family anatomy: constructs of black rubble and crystal assembled around a dark eclipsed orb. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: half the body armoured in GKOM crystal, natural patches between the plates; the crystals are black eclipse crystal with a violet rim. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, strong shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
